subject: planner: add Fix52592 control to disallow fast path (#56097)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent (7c88876a7f): adds fix-control `Fix52592` (via `tidb_opt_fix_control`) to disable PointGet/BatchPointGet fast paths by (1) short-circuiting `TryFastPlan` and (2) preventing CBO conversion to [Batch]PointGet in `findBestTask4DS`; includes a unit test asserting EXPLAIN switches from `Point_Get` to `TableReader/TableRangeScan` when `52592:ON`. No Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics/txn-session behavior for this change (default remains unchanged; opt-in only).
